Request received

Dear {{form.requester_name}},

We received your request for: {{form.records_sought}} ({{date_range}}).

Your reference is {{reference}}. Under {{legal_basis}} we aim to respond by {{due_date}} ({{deadline_days}} {{day_type}}). If we need more time we will tell you before then.

Released records may have parts withheld or redacted (for example faces, licence plates or personal details of other people). Each redaction is reviewed by a person before release.
